title.en: Water: the origin of life and its secret
title.ur: Paani: zindagi ki asal aur uska raaz

title.en: Reading: Water is the origin of life
title.ur: Parhna: Paani zindagi ki asal hai

intro.en: In this lesson we read a passage about water: why every living thing needs it, how much water is in our bodies, and why we must protect it. Read slowly, one sentence at a time.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum paani ke bare mein ek mazmoon parhenge: har zinda cheez ko paani kyun chahiye, hamare jism mein kitna paani hai, aur hamein is ki hifazat kyun karni chahiye. Aaram se, ek jumla ek jumla parhein.
intro.ar: نَقْرَأُ نَصّاً عَنِ الماءِ: لِماذا يَحْتاجُهُ كُلُّ كائِنٍ حَيٍّ، وَكَمْ نِسْبَتُهُ في أَجْسامِنا، وَلِماذا يَجِبُ أَنْ نَحْفَظَهُ. نَقْرَأُ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً بِهُدوءٍ.

dialogue.ar: لا يَسْتَطيعُ كائِنٌ حَيٌّ أَنْ يَعيشَ بِلا ماءٍ، فَهُوَ أَصْلُ الحَياةِ وَسِرُّها.
dialogue.tr: lā yastaṭīʿu kāʾinun ḥayyun an yaʿīsha bi-lā māʾin, fa-huwa aṣlu l-ḥayāti wa-sirruhā
dialogue.en: No living thing can live without water, for it is the origin of life and its secret.
dialogue.ur: Koi zindah makhlooq paani ke bagair zinda nahin reh sakti, kyunke paani zindagi ki asal aur uska raaz hai.

dialogue.ar: قالَ اللهُ تَعالى: ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حَيٍّ  أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾.
dialogue.tr: qāla llāhu taʿālā: wa jaʿalnā mina l-māʾi kulla shayʾin ḥayyin afalā yuʾminūn
dialogue.en: Allah the Most High said: «And We made from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?» (Al-Anbiya 30)
dialogue.ur: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: «Aur hum ne paani se har zinda cheez banai. Phir kya woh imaan nahin laate?» (Al-Anbiya)

dialogue.ar: فَالنَّباتُ يَنْمو مِنَ البُذورِ حينَ يَصِلُ إِلَيْها الماءُ، وَيَذْبُلُ في الصَّحْراءِ إِذا اشْتَدَّ الجَفافُ.
dialogue.tr: fa-n-nabātu yanmū mina l-budhūri ḥīna yaṣilu ilayhā l-māʾ, wa-yadhbulu fī ṣ-ṣaḥrāʾi idhā shtadda l-jafāf
dialogue.en: A plant grows from seeds when water reaches them, and withers in the desert when the drought is severe.
dialogue.ur: Paudha beejon se tab ugta hai jab unhein paani milta hai, aur registan mein sookha shadeed ho to murjha jata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتُعْطينا الأَرْضُ الخُضْراواتِ وَالفَواكِهَ، وَمِنْها الخِيارُ وَالطَّماطِمُ، وَأَكْثَرُها ماءٌ.
dialogue.tr: wa-tuʿṭīnā l-arḍu l-khuḍrāwāti wa-l-fawākih, wa-minhā l-khiyāru wa-ṭ-ṭamāṭim, wa-aktharuhā māʾ
dialogue.en: The earth gives us vegetables and fruits, among them cucumbers and tomatoes, and most of them is water.
dialogue.ur: Zameen hamein sabziyan aur phal deti hai, jin mein kheera aur tamatar hain, aur unka zyada hissa paani hota hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَبْلُغُ الماءُ في جِسْمِ الإِنْسانِ حَوالَيْ ثُلُثَيْهِ، وَهُوَ في كُلِّ خَلِيَّةٍ مِنْ خَلاياهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa-yablughu l-māʾu fī jismi l-insāni ḥawālay thuluthayh, wa-huwa fī kulli khaliyyatin min khalāyāh
dialogue.en: Water makes up about two thirds of a person's body, and it is in every one of his cells.
dialogue.ur: Insani jism mein paani taqreeban do tihai hota hai, aur woh jism ke har khaliye mein maujood hai.

dialogue.ar: وَبِالماءِ يَهْضِمُ الجِسْمُ الغِذاءَ وَيَتَنَفَّسُ وَيَتَحَرَّكُ، وَيَطْرُدُ النُّفاياتِ السّامَّةَ.
dialogue.tr: wa-bi-l-māʾi yahḍimu l-jismu l-ghidhāʾa wa-yatanaffasu wa-yataḥarraku, wa-yaṭrudu n-nufāyāti s-sāmma
dialogue.en: With water the body digests food, breathes and moves, and drives out poisonous waste.
dialogue.ur: Paani ki madad se jism khana hazam karta hai, saans leta hai, harkat karta hai aur zehreeli nafaayat nikalta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَفْقِدُ الجِسْمُ بَعْضَ الماءِ في العَرَقِ وَالدُّموعِ وَالبَوْلِ، فَعَلَيْنا أَنْ نُعَوِّضَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa-yafqidu l-jismu baʿḍa l-māʾi fī l-ʿaraqi wa-d-dumūʿi wa-l-bawl, fa-ʿalaynā an nuʿawwiḍah
dialogue.en: The body loses some water in sweat, tears and urine, so we must replace it.
dialogue.ur: Jism paseene, aansuon aur peshab mein kuch paani kho deta hai, isliye hamein use poora karna chahiye.

dialogue.ar: وَنَحْصُلُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ ثَلاثَةِ مَصادِرَ: ما نَشْرَبُ، وَالخُضْراواتِ وَالفَواكِهِ، وَالأَغْذِيَةِ الصُّلْبَةِ كَالخُبْزِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-naḥṣulu ʿalayhi min thalāthati maṣādira: mā nashrab, wa-l-khuḍrāwāti wa-l-fawākih, wa-l-aghdhiyati ṣ-ṣulbati ka-l-khubz
dialogue.en: We get it from three sources: what we drink, vegetables and fruits, and solid foods such as bread.
dialogue.ur: Hum use teen zariyon se hasil karte hain: jo peete hain, sabziyon aur phalon se, aur thos ghizaon jaise roti se.

dialogue.ar: وَيُنَظِّمُ الماءُ حَرارَةَ الجِسْمِ، فَإِذا ارْتَفَعَتْ أَخْرَجَ الجِلْدُ العَرَقَ لِيُبَرِّدَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa-yunaẓẓimu l-māʾu ḥarārata l-jismi, fa-idhā rtafaʿat akhraja l-jildu l-ʿaraqa li-yubarridah
dialogue.en: Water regulates the body's heat, and when it rises the skin lets out sweat to cool it.
dialogue.ur: Paani jism ki hararat ko theek rakhta hai, aur jab woh barh jaye to jild paseena nikal kar use thanda karti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَإِذا حُرِمَ الإِنْسانُ مِنَ الماءِ أَصابَهُ الظَّمَأُ، وَقَدْ يُؤَدّي ذلِكَ إِلى الهَلاكِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-idhā ḥurima l-insānu mina l-māʾi aṣābahu ẓ-ẓamaʾ, wa-qad yuʾaddī dhālika ilā l-halāk
dialogue.en: If a person is deprived of water, thirst strikes him, and that may lead to death.
dialogue.ur: Agar insan ko paani na mile to use pyaas lagti hai, aur yeh halakat tak pahuncha sakti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهُوَ نِعْمَةٌ مِنَ اللهِ تَجْري في الأَنْهارِ وَالبِحارِ وَالمُحيطاتِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-huwa niʿmatun mina llāhi tajrī fī l-anhāri wa-l-biḥāri wa-l-muḥīṭāt
dialogue.en: It is a blessing from Allah that flows in rivers, seas and oceans.
dialogue.ur: Yeh Allah ki naimat hai jo nadiyon, samundaron aur bahron mein behti hai.

dialogue.ar: فَلْنَحْفَظْهُ مِنَ التَّلَوُّثِ، وَلْنَسْتَعْمِلْهُ بِقَدْرِ الحاجَةِ دونَ إِسْرافٍ.
dialogue.tr: fa-l-naḥfaẓhu mina t-talawwuthi, wa-l-nastaʿmilhu bi-qadri l-ḥājati dūna isrāf
dialogue.en: So let us keep it from pollution and use it as much as we need, without waste.
dialogue.ur: Aayein hum use aloodgi se bachayein aur zaroorat ke mutabiq istemaal karein, israaf ke baghair.

q.en: According to the text, what is the origin of life?
q.ur: Mazmoon ke mutabiq zindagi ki asal kya hai?

q.en: About how much of the human body is water?
q.ur: Insaan ke jism ka taqriban kitna hissa paani hai?
q.ar: كَمْ تَبْلُغُ نِسْبَةُ الماءِ تَقْريباً في جِسْمِ الإِنْسانِ؟

options: Half of one percent / Aadha feesad

q.en: What does «نِعْمَة» mean?
q.ur: «نِعْمَة» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: How many main sources of water does a person get it from?
q.ur: Insaan ko paani kitne bade zaraye se milta hai?
q.ar: مِنْ كَمْ مَصْدَرٍ رَئيسٍ يَحْصُلُ الإِنْسانُ عَلى الماءِ؟

q.en: What must we do with the blessing of water?
q.ur: Paani ki naimat ke sath hamein kya karna chahiye?
q.ar: ماذا يَجِبُ أَنْ نَفْعَلَ بِنِعْمَةِ الماءِ؟

options: Protect it and not waste it / Hifazat karein, israaf na karein
Use as much as we like / Jitna chahein istemaal karein
Keep it away from people / Logon se door rakhein
Mix it with waste / Kachre mein milayein

intro.en: Now we check that we understood the passage: put its ideas in order, answer questions, and practise words such as «بِدون» (without) and «لَولا» (if it were not for).
intro.ur: Ab hum dekhte hain ke mazmoon samajh aaya ya nahin: khayalat ko tarteeb dein, sawalon ke jawab dein, aur «بِدون» (baghair) aur «لَولا» (agar na hota) jaise alfaaz ki mashq karein.
intro.ar: نَتَأَكَّدُ الآنَ مِنْ فَهْمِ النَّصِّ: نُرَتِّبُ أَفْكارَهُ، وَنُجيبُ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةٍ، وَنَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى كَلِماتٍ مِثْلِ «بِدون» وَ«لَولا».

vocab.ur: agar na hota / agar yeh na hota

q.en: What does «بِدون» mean?
q.ur: «بِدون» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: «لَولا الماءُ ما كانَتِ الحَياةُ» means:
q.ur: «لَولا الماءُ ما كانَتِ الحَياةُ» ka matlab:
q.ar: ما مَعْنى «لَولا الماءُ ما كانَتِ الحَياةُ»؟

options: If it were not for water, there would be no life / Paani na hota to zindagi na hoti
Water is life only for plants / Paani sirf paudhon ki zindagi hai
Life is more than water / Zindagi paani se zyada hai
Water came after life / Paani zindagi ke baad aaya
options_ar: لَوْ لَمْ يُوجَدِ الماءُ لَما وُجِدَتِ الحَياةُ

q.en: What is the plural of «يَوْم» (day) used in this unit?
q.ur: «يَوْم» ka jama kaun sa hai?
q.ar: ما جَمْعُ «يَوْم» المُسْتَعْمَلُ في هذِهِ الوَحْدَةِ؟

q.en: «اجْتِهاد» is closest to:
q.ur: «اجْتِهاد» kis ke qareeb hai?

title.en: Grammar A: Verbal nouns of four-letter verbs
title.ur: Qawaid (A): Chaar harfi fe'l ke masdar

intro.en: A masdar is the verbal noun, the name of an action (like «reading» from «read»). Four-letter verbs follow patterns. Example: أَكْرَمَ becomes إِكْرام; سَلَّمَ becomes تَسْليم; قاتَلَ becomes قِتال or مُقاتَلَة; دَحْرَجَ becomes دَحْرَجَة.
intro.ur: Masdar woh ism hai jo kaam ka naam batata hai (jaise «parhna» «parha» se). Chaar harfi af'aal ke wazan hote hain. Misal: أَكْرَمَ se إِكْرام; سَلَّمَ se تَسْليم; قاتَلَ se قِتال ya مُقاتَلَة; دَحْرَجَ se دَحْرَجَة.
intro.ar: المَصْدَرُ اسْمٌ يَدُلُّ عَلى الحَدَثِ، مِثْلُ «القِراءَةِ» مِنْ «قَرَأَ». وَلِلأَفْعالِ الرُّباعِيَّةِ أَوْزانٌ: أَكْرَمَ: إِكْرام، وَسَلَّمَ: تَسْليم، وَقاتَلَ: قِتال أَوْ مُقاتَلَة، وَدَحْرَجَ: دَحْرَجَة.

dialogue.ar: أَقْدَمَ الفَتى عَلى إِنْقاذِ الطِّفْلِ إِقْداماً.
dialogue.tr: aqdama l-fatā ʿalā inqādhi ṭ-ṭifli iqdāman
dialogue.en: The young man boldly moved to rescue the child.
dialogue.ur: Naujawan ne bachay ko bachane ke liye himmat se qadam barhaya.

dialogue.en: The father advised his son to be truthful.
dialogue.ur: Baap ne bete ko sachai ki wasiyyat ki.

dialogue.ar: خاصَمَ الجارُ جارَهُ خِصاماً أَوْ مُخاصَمَةً.
dialogue.tr: khāṣama l-jāru jārahu khiṣāman aw mukhāṣama
dialogue.en: The neighbour quarrelled with his neighbour.
dialogue.ur: Padosi ne apne padosi se jhagda kiya.

dialogue.en: The girl forgave her friend.
dialogue.ur: Ladki ne apni saheli ko maaf kar diya.

dialogue.en: The boy answered his mother's call.
dialogue.ur: Larke ne apni ammi ki pukaar par labbaik kaha.

dialogue.en: The heater warmed the room.
dialogue.ur: Heater ne kamre ko garam kar diya.

q.en: What is the masdar of أَكْرَمَ?
q.ur: أَكْرَمَ ka masdar kaun sa hai?

q.en: What is the masdar of سَلَّمَ?
q.ur: سَلَّمَ ka masdar kaun sa hai?

q.en: Which are the two masdars of قاتَلَ?
q.ur: قاتَلَ ke do masdar kaun se hain?

q.en: What is the masdar of دَحْرَجَ?
q.ur: دَحْرَجَ ka masdar kaun sa hai?

q.en: What does «زِلْزال» mean?
q.ur: «زِلْزال» ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: After listening to the text, we answer true or false questions about water. Remember what the passage taught us: water is life, and we should not keep animals from it.
intro.ur: Matn sunne ke baad hum paani ke bare mein sahi ya ghalat ke sawalon ke jawab dete hain. Yaad rakhein: paani zindagi hai, aur janwar ko paani se rokna jaiz nahin.
intro.ar: بَعْدَ الاسْتِماعِ إِلى النَّصِّ نُجيبُ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةِ الصَّوابِ وَالخَطَأِ حَوْلَ الماءِ. نَتَذَكَّرُ أَنَّ الماءَ حَياةٌ، وَأَنَّنا لا نَمْنَعُ الحَيَواناتِ مِنْهُ.

q.en: True or false: «لَوْلا الماءُ لَما كانَتِ الحَياةُ».
q.ur: Sahi ya ghalat: «لَوْلا الماءُ لَما كانَتِ الحَياةُ».
q.ar: هَلْ جُمْلَةُ «لَوْلا الماءُ لَما كانَتِ الحَياةُ» صَحيحَةٌ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

options: Only for plants / Sirf paudhon ke liye

q.en: What do we use water for?
q.ur: Hum paani kis kaam mein istemaal karte hain?

q.en: What do dams and reservoirs help us do?
q.ur: Band aur zakheere hamari kya madad karte hain?
q.ar: ماذا تُساعِدُنا السُّدودُ وَالخَزّاناتُ عَلى أَنْ نَفْعَلَ؟

q.en: What is «صَلاةُ الاسْتِسْقاء»?
q.ur: «صَلاةُ الاسْتِسْقاء» kya hai?

options: The prayer asking for rain / Baarish ke liye dua ki namaz
The prayer of travel / Safar ki namaz
The Friday prayer / Jumma ki namaz
The prayer of fear / Khauf ki namaz
options_ar: صَلاةٌ نَدْعو فيها اللهَ أَنْ يُنْزِلَ المَطَرَ

intro.en: Speak with your classmates about the sources of water: rain, wells, rivers and seas, and others. Then write a few sentences of your own about water.
intro.ur: Apne saathiyon se paani ke zaraye ke bare mein baat karein: baarish, kuein, nadiyan, samandar aur doosre. Phir paani ke bare mein apne chand jumle likhein.
intro.ar: نَتَحَدَّثُ مَعَ زُمَلائِنا عَنْ مَصادِرِ الماءِ: الأَمْطارِ وَالآبارِ وَالأَنْهارِ وَالبِحارِ وَغَيْرِها. ثُمَّ نَكْتُبُ جُمَلاً مِنْ عِنْدِنا عَنِ الماءِ.

q.en: Which one is a source of water?
q.ur: In mein se paani ka zariya kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ هذِهِ مَصْدَرٌ مِنْ مَصادِرِ الماءِ؟

q.en: What does «الآبار» mean?
q.ur: «الآبار» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: أَماكِنُ مَحْفورَةٌ في الأَرْضِ يُسْتَخْرَجُ مِنْها الماءُ

q.en: What does «زُمَلاء» mean?
q.ur: «زُمَلاء» ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: Arabic uses punctuation marks like English. The full stop (.) ends a complete sentence. The comma (،) comes after a called name, between items, or after an answer word like نَعَم. The colon (:) comes after «he said». The question mark (؟) ends a question.
intro.ur: Arabi mein bhi English ki tarah alamaat hoti hain. Nuqta (.) mukammal jumle ke akhir mein aata hai. Fasila (،) pukare gaye naam ke baad, cheezon ke darmiyan, ya نَعَم jaise jawabi lafz ke baad aata hai. Do nuqte (:) «us ne kaha» ke baad aate hain. Sawaliya nishaan (؟) sawal ke akhir mein aata hai.
intro.ar: في العَرَبِيَّةِ عَلاماتُ تَرْقيمٍ: النُّقْطَةُ (.) في آخِرِ الجُمْلَةِ التّامَّةِ، وَالفاصِلَةُ (،) بَعْدَ المُنادى وَبَيْنَ المُفْرَداتِ وَبَعْدَ كَلِمَةِ الجَوابِ مِثْلِ «نَعَمْ»، وَالنُّقْطَتانِ (:) بَعْدَ «قالَ»، وَعَلامَةُ الاسْتِفْهامِ (؟) في آخِرِ السُّؤالِ.

dialogue.en: The sun set. (full stop)
dialogue.ur: Sooraj doob gaya. (nuqta)

dialogue.en: O Khalid, read the lesson. (comma after the called name)
dialogue.ur: Ae Khalid, sabaq parho. (pukare gaye naam ke baad fasila)

dialogue.en: Yes, I understood the lesson. (comma after the answer word)
dialogue.ur: Haan, main ne sabaq samajh liya. (jawab ke lafz ke baad fasila)

dialogue.en: When does your sister come back from school? (question mark)
dialogue.ur: Aapki behan school se kab wapas aati hai? (sawaliya nishaan)

dialogue.en: The teacher said: Write the answer. (colon after «said»)
dialogue.ur: Ustaad ne kaha: jawab likho. ("kaha" ke baad do nuqte)

q.en: Which mark ends a question?
q.ur: Sawal ke akhir mein kaun si alamat aati hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عَلامَةٍ تُوضَعُ في آخِرِ السُّؤالِ؟

q.en: What is the Arabic name for the full stop?
q.ur: Nuqte ko Arabi mein kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ما اسْمُ العَلامَةِ (.) في آخِرِ الجُمْلَةِ؟

q.en: What does «الفاصِلَة» mean?
q.ur: «الفاصِلَة» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Where do we put a comma in «يا خالِدُ اقْرَأِ الدَّرْسَ»?

title.ar: قَواعِدُ اللُّغَةِ (ب): مَصادِرُ الأَفْعالِ الخُماسِيَّةِ وَالسُّداسِيَّة
title.en: Grammar B: Verbal nouns of five and six-letter verbs
title.ur: Qawaid (B): Paanch aur chhe harfi fe'l ke masdar

intro.en: Five and six-letter verbs also have patterns. Example: تَعَلَّمَ becomes تَعَلُّم; اشْتَدَّ becomes اشْتِداد; اسْتَقامَ becomes اسْتِقامَة. Look at the long vowel before the last letter (ا) in the masdar.
intro.ur: Paanch aur chhe harfi af'aal ke bhi wazan hain. Misal: تَعَلَّمَ se تَعَلُّم; اشْتَدَّ se اشْتِداد; اسْتَقامَ se اسْتِقامَة. Masdar mein aakhri harf se pehle alif (ا) par dhyan dein.
intro.ar: لِلأَفْعالِ الخُماسِيَّةِ وَالسُّداسِيَّةِ أَوْزانٌ أَيْضاً: تَعَلَّمَ: تَعَلُّم، وَاشْتَدَّ: اشْتِداد، وَاسْتَقامَ: اسْتِقامَة. لاحِظِ الأَلِفَ قَبْلَ الحَرْفِ الأَخيرِ في المَصْدَرِ.
